title: Contact
intro: WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us. The office is in Ankara and runs on Turkish time, which is ahead of Ghana and Nigeria.

children.text: We reply within four working hours. Our office is open 09:00 to 18:00 in Türkiye, which is shown converted to your own local time in the footer of every page.
For a first enquiry: what you want to study, roughly what your grades were, and what you can spend. That is enough for us to tell you something useful rather than something generic.
You do not need documents yet. Nothing has to be scanned, translated or notarised before a first conversation.
